practices.name: Primary and secondary schooling
practices.scope: Who pays for and runs compulsory schooling, and how pupils, classes and schools are organised.

practices.name: Higher education
practices.scope: Who pays for, provides and admits students to universities and colleges, and how tuition and student support work.

practices.name: Vocational training and apprenticeship
practices.scope: How people learn a trade, in schools or in workplaces through apprenticeships, and who pays for it.

practices.name: Early childhood care and education
practices.scope: Care and learning for children before compulsory school, who provides it and who pays for it.

practices.name: Adult and lifelong learning
practices.scope: Learning after the main education: retraining, second-chance courses and evening classes, and who pays for them.

practices.name: Teacher pay, training and status
practices.scope: How teachers are paid, trained, selected, promoted and respected, and who sets those rules.

practices.name: Health financing
practices.scope: How care is paid for: taxes, insurance contributions, out-of-pocket payment or a mix of these.

practices.name: Hospitals and clinics
practices.scope: Who owns, runs and staffs hospitals and clinics, and how they are paid.

practices.name: Medicines and drug research
practices.scope: How new drugs are researched, priced, patented and supplied.

practices.name: Doctors' training and pay
practices.scope: How doctors and nurses are trained, licensed, paid and spread across regions.

practices.name: Mental health care
practices.scope: Who provides and pays for psychological and psychiatric care, and how waiting times and stigma are handled.

practices.name: Care for older and dying people
practices.scope: Who provides and pays for care at home and in homes for older and dying people.

practices.name: Public health and vaccination
practices.scope: Who organises vaccination, screening, sanitation and health campaigns, and who pays for them.

practices.name: Elections and political money
practices.scope: How candidates are chosen and funded, and how votes are counted and contested.

practices.name: Public administration and bureaucracy
practices.scope: How the civil service is recruited, paid, supervised and held to account.

practices.name: Ownership of strategic industries
practices.scope: Which firms and sectors the state owns or controls, such as energy, rail and banks.

practices.name: Taxation
practices.scope: Which taxes fund the state, how progressive they are, and who pays them.

practices.name: Regulation and competition
practices.scope: How markets are regulated, monopolies are controlled and consumers are protected.

practices.name: Local government and decentralisation
practices.scope: How much power, money and decision-making sits in towns and regions rather than at the centre.

practices.name: Wages and minimum wages
practices.scope: How pay is set, whether a legal minimum exists, and who sets it.

practices.name: Trade unions and worker voice
practices.scope: How workers organise, bargain and have a say in decisions at work.

practices.name: Working time and paid leave
practices.scope: Hours of work, holidays, parental and sick leave, and who sets them.

practices.name: Unemployment and job security
practices.scope: How people who lose work are protected, retrained and supported.

practices.name: Worker ownership and co-determination
practices.scope: Whether workers own the firms they work in, or sit on their boards.

practices.name: Automation and technological change
practices.scope: Who gains and who loses when machines replace work, and who decides how fast this happens.

practices.name: Money creation and central banking
practices.scope: Who creates money, sets interest rates and controls the currency.

practices.name: Banking and credit
practices.scope: Who lends, who owns the banks, and who gets credit on what terms.

practices.name: Pensions and retirement
practices.scope: How income in old age is funded: pay-as-you-go schemes, savings funds or the state.

practices.name: Social and private insurance
practices.scope: How risks such as illness, accident, unemployment and disaster are shared.

practices.name: Public debt
practices.scope: How governments borrow, how debt is repaid, and who holds it.

practices.name: Media ownership and public broadcasting
practices.scope: Who owns newspapers, broadcasters and platforms, and how public broadcasting is funded.

practices.name: Film, music and the arts
practices.scope: How films, music, theatre and visual arts are funded, distributed and judged.

practices.name: Copyright and cultural property
practices.scope: How creators are rewarded, how long rights last, and who may copy and share.

practices.name: Sport and professional leagues
practices.scope: Who runs and funds sport, professional leagues, clubs and mass participation.

practices.name: Games, gambling and lotteries
practices.scope: How games of chance are run, taxed and restricted.

practices.name: Holidays and free time
practices.scope: How much free time people have and who provides holidays and leisure.

practices.name: Parks, libraries and public spaces
practices.scope: Who provides and maintains parks, libraries and other free public facilities.

practices.name: Tourism
practices.scope: Who profits from visitors, and who bears the costs of tourism.

practices.name: Hobbies, clubs and makerspaces
practices.scope: How hobby groups, clubs and workshops are organised and funded.

practices.name: Housing and rent
practices.scope: Who owns, builds and rents homes, and how rents are set.

practices.name: Urban planning and public space
practices.scope: Who decides how towns grow, what is built, and where people can meet.

practices.name: Charity, mutual aid and philanthropy
practices.scope: How people help each other outside the state: charities, mutual aid and donors.

practices.name: Volunteering and civic associations
practices.scope: How volunteers and civic groups are organised, recognised and funded.

practices.name: Religious life and its institutions
practices.scope: How religious communities are funded, governed and regulated.

practices.name: Food sharing and communal kitchens
practices.scope: How food is shared outside the market: communal meals, food banks and gleaning.

practices.name: Marriage and partnership law
practices.scope: How partnerships are recognised, and what they entitle the partners to.

practices.name: Childcare and parental leave
practices.scope: Who cares for children while parents work, and who pays for leave and care.

practices.name: Unpaid domestic and care work
practices.scope: Who does unpaid housework and care, and whether that work is counted or paid.

practices.name: Family planning and contraception
practices.scope: Who provides contraception and abortion services, and who pays for them.

practices.name: Sex education and sexual health services
practices.scope: What young people are taught about sex, and who provides testing, treatment and advice.

practices.name: Sex work and its legal status
practices.scope: How paid sex is treated in law, and what that means for workers' safety and income.

practices.name: Divorce and property after a partnership ends
practices.scope: How property, debts and children are divided when partnerships end.

practices.name: Carbon pricing and climate policy
practices.scope: How emissions are priced or limited, and who pays the costs.

practices.name: Energy supply
practices.scope: Who produces, owns and sells energy, and how supply is kept reliable and affordable.

practices.name: Land and natural resources
practices.scope: Who owns land, forests and minerals, and who receives their rent.

practices.name: Waste and circular economy
practices.scope: How waste is collected, reused, recycled or landfilled, and who pays.

practices.name: Shared resources such as fisheries and water
practices.scope: How shared resources such as fisheries, water and grazing land are managed.

practices.name: Public transport and fares
practices.scope: Who runs buses and trains, and how fares are set.

practices.name: Car ownership and road pricing
practices.scope: How roads are paid for, and whether drivers pay for congestion and for the space they use.

practices.name: Public research funding
practices.scope: How science is funded: project grants, institutes and block funding for universities.

practices.name: Patents and open knowledge
practices.scope: Who may own inventions and data, and how long monopolies last.

practices.name: Access to information and archives
practices.scope: Who may read public records, data and archives, and at what cost.

practices.name: Courts and access to justice
practices.scope: Who runs the courts, who pays for lawyers, and how quickly disputes are settled.

practices.name: Prisons
practices.scope: Who runs prisons, how they are paid for, and whether they may be run for profit.

practices.name: Policing
practices.scope: Who pays for and controls the police, and how they are held to account.

practices.name: Military service
practices.scope: Whether defence relies on conscription or volunteers, and how soldiers are paid.

practices.name: Migration and citizenship
practices.scope: Who may move, work and become citizens, and who pays for newcomers.

practices.name: Postal service and broadband access
practices.scope: Who provides post and internet access, and whether everyone is guaranteed it.

practices.name: Online platforms and personal data
practices.scope: Who owns online platforms and personal data, and how users are protected.

practices.name: Tariffs and free trade
practices.scope: Whether goods cross borders freely, and who gains or loses from tariffs.

practices.name: Foreign aid and development finance
practices.scope: Who gives aid and loans to poorer countries, and on what conditions.

practices.name: Sanctions and economic statecraft
practices.scope: When and why states use trade, money or investment as instruments of policy, and who pays the costs.

practices.name: Land tenure for farmers
practices.scope: Who owns or rents farmland, and what security farmers have.

practices.name: Food safety and subsidies
practices.scope: Who sets food rules and pays farm subsidies, and who benefits from them.

practices.name: Food distribution and waste
practices.scope: How food moves from farm to table, and how much of it is wasted.
